notes.title: [v0.180.0b] Update just before tank implementation
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42625821/5e740c325a45e2082c3844a29808e757ecc4e57d.png

It was discovered that if a language other than English was selected during installation, the installation would not work correctly.
This should be fixed now, but since we had to update the build many times through trial and error, we decided to build and hang an update with the current state of development.

*Save data compatibility will be lost!

The updates are as follows

Finally, the "darkness" is coming, which is a must for rogues! You can only see one step in front of you in the passage.
Sorting of items has been implemented.
Dashing now stops at room entrances and exits.

The implementation of tanks has been very slow due to many bugs, but we are still making steady progress.
Please wait for further updates.

notes.title: v0.136.3b : Major update (first half)
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42625821/9c336d1c853d74c419c0a702023d9e45d17a4794.png

Thank you for your patience.
We have finally completed the game engine and are ready to start working on the game in earnest.
We would like to thank all of you who have supported us. Thank you.

At the beginning of the new year, we will implement the tank system as the second half of a major update.
The tank system itself is ready, but the balance and item creation are not ready in time.

However, we will do our best during the New Year holidays to deliver it as soon as possible.
Please look forward to it.

Have a Happy New Year!

notes.title: Update v0.29.1b
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42625821/4be94f2a89a062c8a92f24c86345ab6ce2cb9af3.png

Items that have been sighted and monsters in view are now displayed on the minimap.

Items that have been placed or thrown down will be visible from the beginning.
Monsters will not appear on the minimap if they are not adjacent to you outside of a room or in a passageway.

In the very near future, equipment will be implemented that will have the effect of constantly displaying items and monsters on the minimap.

notes.title: Update 0.26.1b
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42625821/8a6cb9dc7e4a1b6ec8586838f244184bc75d2642.png

We have implemented a small window that compares the item's description window and the weapon/armor you are currently equipping with the one at the cursor position. The description window is larger because we plan to add multiple enchantments to items in the future.

The next update will include the display of enemies and items on the map and the display of icons in front of items in the inventory.

notes.title: Update v0.22.1b
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42625821/7901618edcef7684494f2ffc5c8c8f53c6e7e04d.png

With this update, save data, storage, and items returning from dungeons have been implemented. The contents of inventory and storage are recorded by actions such as returning to the dungeon, departing, and returning to the title screen.

Manual saving is expected to be implemented in the next update. Similarly, NECOPO recording will be implemented in the next update.

The ability to expand the warehouse using NECOPO will be addressed in a later update.

We had planned to implement item crafting next, but based on your feedback, we plan to implement tanks on a trial basis first. Please look forward to it.

notes.title: Upcoming Update Announcements
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42625821/a65128aef2f24780a4ea5f0b994dda851739859f.png

Upcoming Update Announcements

- Implementation of items that return from dungeons with items in their possession.
- Warehouses will be implemented at bases to store items brought back
- Support for save and load

The data to be loaded will be in the style you select when you start the game. Loading during game play is not possible, and the game will auto-save when you return to your base. Players can also save at any point in the base.

The game will auto-save when the player enters the dungeon and when the player moves floors.

Auto-save at each step will be implemented at a later date. This will be implemented at the same time as the interrupted save during dungeon exploration.
